description: THE BLIND SPOT — a GROUNDED retinal field, not a sample array. The optic disc (gsensed=0, no photoreceptors, no data) is FILLED FROM the surround by grounding: a contour is bridged AS a contour (its axis is carried and propagates only along it), a consistent fill makes the hole invisible, an ambiguous surround is HELD OPEN, and the belief REVISES when the eye moves. Pure seed rules reusing vision_lateral's LOCAL Neighbours/Filter/Count/Sum machinery (O(N) per run_rules sweep, NOT the O(N^2) apply_rule_once drive). The blind-spot geometry is a STRUCTURAL construction parameter (the optic nerve must exit somewhere); the FILLING falls out, and the confidence decay is RELATIVE to surround support. Ships INERT (ground=0, interp=0) so every committed result reproduces (PROTOCOL 9). v1.1.0 (VISION_AGNOSIA_PREREG.md, FRONTIER T9): adds the ABSENCE-TOLERANT `AgnosiaParams.apperceptive` ablation guard to gr_fill (percept COMPLETION) as the APPERCEPTIVE-agnosia lesion. The guard is Count(Filter(NodesOfType(AgnosiaParams), ap, ap.apperceptive > 0.5)) < 1, so a graph with NO AgnosiaParams node is INTACT -- byte-identical to v1.0.0. gr_label and gr_interp are NOT guarded: contour labelling still runs and it is the FORMING of the percept that the lesion destroys.

microtheory.name: grounded_retinal_field
microtheory.description: Vision is a grounded field: a belief per location, filled from the surround where the sensor has no data. The blind spot proves it — a hole in the retina we do not perceive, because the field grounds the absence from what surrounds it (the edges-are-grounded-contours principle: transitive, decaying, relative grounding). Interpolation averages the hole (one invented value, blur, confabulation); grounding continues the STRUCTURE and holds genuine ambiguity open.

rules.name: gr_label
rules.comment: A SENSED cell is labelled a contour (axis 1 = runs along the row, 2 = along the column) iff its observation is CONSTANT along that axis and DIFFERS along the perpendicular one. No magic number: exact equality on the observed value. Once per step (glabel_step < ret.step).

rules.name: gr_fill
rules.comment: The unified grounding fill: contour-first (continue a contour along its carried axis), else surface (mean of filled surface neighbours), and HOLD OPEN a conflicting two-continuation surround (gambig=1, stay unfilled). One rule = no inter-rule race. gconf falls out of support.

rules.name: gr_interp
rules.comment: INTERPOLATION control (interp=1): mean of ALL filled neighbours, no structure. Blurs contours and confabulates ambiguity — the baseline.
